name: Grid / GridItem
description: Typed CSS grid with column counts per breakpoint (literal utilities that survive purging), auto-fit min-column mode, and GridItem spans.
designIntent: Grid layout should be declarative without stepping on Tailwind's compiler: column counts map to literal class names the scanner can see, and responsive card grids use minmax() auto-fit via minCol — no breakpoint math, no purged runtime-built classes. GridItem adds per-cell spans with the same literal approach.

props.name: smCols
props.description: Columns from the sm breakpoint up (1-6).

props.name: mdCols
props.description: Columns from the md breakpoint up (1-6).

props.name: lgCols
props.description: Columns from the lg breakpoint up (1-6).

props.name: minCol
props.description: Auto-fit mode: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(<minCol>, 1fr)) — cards wrap responsively. Overrides the cols* props.

props.name: as
props.description: Semantic element (use 'ul' with GridItem as="li" for item grids).

props.name: span
props.description: GridItem column span at the base breakpoint (1-6).

props.name: smSpan
props.description: GridItem column span from sm up (1-6).

props.name: mdSpan
props.description: GridItem column span from md up (1-6).

props.name: lgSpan
props.description: GridItem column span from lg up (1-6).

examples.title: Responsive card grid (auto-fit)
examples.description: minmax() wrapping — works at every width without breakpoint columns.

examples.title: Fixed columns with a hero span
examples.code:
<Grid cols={2} mdCols={3} gap="md">
  <GridItem span={2} mdSpan={2} className="…">Hero</GridItem>
  <GridItem>Card A</GridItem>
  <GridItem>Card B</GridItem>
</Grid>
examples.description: Literal grid-cols-*/col-span-* classes are compiled (they exist verbatim in source).

antiPatterns.title: Don't build column classes at runtime
antiPatterns.explanation: Template-built utilities (md:grid-cols-${n}) are invisible to Tailwind's scanner and get purged — the grid silently collapses to one column. The cols props use pre-declared literal classes.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest grids for one-axis layouts
antiPatterns.explanation: Row/column alignment is Flex's job; nesting grids adds template complexity with no benefit.

accessibility.implementation: Renders div/section/ul — no interactive behavior added
accessibility.userRequirements: Cells keep their own roles; list grids pair as="ul" with GridItem as="li"

accessibility.implementation: Visual column reflow never reorders DOM nodes
accessibility.userRequirements: Order cells by reading priority, not visual position

compositionRules.relationship: Flex for one-axis rows; Grid for two-axis layout
